description: This file implements functions related to high-resolution timing, including obtaining the current time, adding milliseconds to a timestamp, calculating elapsed time, comparing timestamps, converting timestamps to string representations, and converting to timespec structures.

methods.name: rtTime_t * rtTime_Now(rtTime_t * t)
methods.description: Populates a provided rtTime_t structure with the current monotonic clock time.

methods.name: void rtTime_Later(const rtTime_t * start,unsigned int ms,rtTime_t * result)
methods.description: Calculates a future time based on a start time plus a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: int rtTime_Elapsed(const rtTime_t * start,const rtTime_t * end)
methods.description: Computes the elapsed milliseconds between two times, optionally using the current time if end is null.

methods.name: int rtTime_Compare(const rtTime_t * left,const rtTime_t * right)
methods.description: Compares two rtTime_t timestamps, returning -1, 0, or 1 based on their ordering.

methods.name: const char * rtTime_ToString(const rtTime_t * tm,char * buffer)
methods.description: Converts an rtTime_t timestamp to a formatted string.

methods.name: const rtTimespec_t * rtTime_ToTimespec(const rtTime_t * tm,rtTimespec_t * result)
methods.description: Converts an rtTime_t timestamp to an rtTimespec_t structure.

ctags.name: rtTime_Compare
ctags.pattern: /^int rtTime_Compare(const rtTime_t* left, const rtTime_t* right)$/

ctags.name: rtTime_Elapsed
ctags.pattern: /^int rtTime_Elapsed(const rtTime_t* start, const rtTime_t* end)$/

ctags.name: rtTime_Later
ctags.pattern: /^void rtTime_Later(const rtTime_t* start, unsigned int  ms, rtTime_t* result)$/

ctags.name: rtTime_ToString
ctags.pattern: /^const char* rtTime_ToString(const rtTime_t* tm, char* buffer)$/

ctags.pattern: /^const rtTimespec_t* rtTime_ToTimespec(const rtTime_t* tm, rtTimespec_t* result)$/
